lines.text: Many learners say: I think he is not coming.
Better: I don't think he is coming.
The second! I don't think it will rain today.

data.wrong: I think he is not coming.
data.right: I don't think he is coming.

options: I think it will not rain today.
I don't think it will rain today.

native.hook: “我觉得不…”要说 I don't think！
native.tip: 中文说“我觉得他不来”，把“不”放在后面。英语习惯把否定放在 think 前面：I don't think。
native.caption: 你是不是也会说 “I think he is not coming.”😅 英语习惯把“不”放在 think 前面，说 I don't think：“I don't think he is coming.”跟着 Ama 老师读一读！在 Lexkite 应用里练习更多。
native.comment: 答案：“I don't think he is coming.”大声读一遍，再写一句你自己的句子。免费测验在这里：{link}

en.tip: English puts not before think, not after it.
en.caption: Do you say “I think he is not coming.” 😅 English puts not before think, not after it: “I don't think he is coming.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
